tests.predictive_sufficiency: Does phi_L retain information needed to predict protected adaptation/transfer beyond lower-level summaries?
tests.causal_autonomy_residual: Under resource-matched interventions, does manipulating organization at L change outcomes after controlling component resources and member capabilities?
tests.heredity_persistence: Is the candidate macro-unit reproduced/persisted with heritable variation rather than an observer cluster?
